context: A boss debriefs his secretary on tomorrow's site visit
purpose: Teach: デスク/ルーム/扉/電波/交代/パック/タウン/大抵

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ちょっと君のデスクまで来てくれ。明日のタウン視察、最終確認しておきたい。
lines.en: Come over to your desk for a moment. I want to finalize tomorrow's town inspection.
lines.style: Authoritative, calls her over with brisk efficiency

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、すぐ参ります。会議ルームのほうがよろしいですか?
lines.en: Yes, I'll come right away. Would the meeting room be better?
lines.style: Polite and accommodating, offering a quiet option

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: いや、ここでいい。先方の現場は山の中で、電波が悪いらしい。連絡手段を二重に用意してくれ。
lines.en: No, here is fine. Their site is in the mountains and reception is bad. Prepare backup communication.
lines.style: Practical and decisive, anticipating logistical issues clearly

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。日帰りパックの新幹線も、朝一番の便で押さえてあります。
lines.en: Understood. I've also reserved the day-trip package on the earliest bullet train.
lines.style: Crisp and reassuringly thorough in her detailed report

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 助かる。それと、午後は私と田中が交代で説明に立つ。資料の差し替えを忘れないでくれ。
lines.en: That helps. Also, Tanaka and I will alternate presenting in the afternoon. Don't forget the document swap.
lines.style: Direct, delegating with clear and firm expectations

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。現場の入口の扉は施錠されているそうなので、警備員の方に事前連絡しておきます。
lines.en: Certainly. I heard the site's entrance door is locked, so I'll notify security in advance.
lines.style: Proactive, thinking several steps ahead of her boss

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 気が利くな。こういう視察は大抵、些細な手違いで時間を食う。今回は綺麗に終わらせたい。
lines.en: Very attentive. These inspections usually waste time on small mistakes. I want this one to go smoothly.
lines.style: Mildly approving, sharing seasoned managerial experience plainly

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 全力でお支えします。では、車両の手配書をデスクにお持ちしますね。
lines.en: I'll support you fully. I'll bring the vehicle arrangement documents to your desk then.
lines.style: Loyal and composed, closing the briefing neatly
